wildstyle.label: Wildstyle
wildstyle.description: Build ATLAS from intricate, interlocking angular letter skeletons with energetic extensions, overlapping bars, sharp cuts and carefully controlled highlights. Give the paint layered depth, hand-worked edges and lively movement, while keeping each of the five primary letter shapes individually recognizable at a glance. Keep every flourish attached to or clearly subordinate to its letter; never let complexity change the exact spelling.

entries.label: Monumental wall
entries.description: Place the entire artwork on one broad, continuous architectural wall large enough to hold the complete word without wrapping around a corner. Show believable wall material, construction joints, weathering and a surface plane that recedes naturally in the chosen view. The pigment must visibly follow and adhere to that plane, with no floating letters or paint extending onto unrelated structures.

entries.label: Freestanding sign
entries.description: Mount the complete painted artwork on a large freestanding urban sign with a credible sign face, visible structural supports and convincing attachment details. Make the sign's thickness, scale and weather exposure readable, and ensure it stands securely within the environment rather than appearing suspended without support. Keep the painted letters confined to the sign face and fully visible.

entries.label: Elevated panel
entries.description: Put the artwork on a substantial elevated panel that is visibly integrated into the site through credible brackets, beams or structural supports. Communicate the panel's material, thickness and height with realistic perspective and contact shadows, while leaving enough clear face for all five letters. Paint must conform to the panel surface and must not become part of the surrounding architecture.

entries.label: Natural lens
entries.description: Photograph with a natural 40mm full-frame-equivalent rectilinear lens, giving the subject familiar proportions and a calm, documentary perspective. Preserve straight architectural lines and realistic relative scale, with neither conspicuous foreshortening nor exaggerated background compression. Keep the whole word sharp enough to read.

entries.label: Moderate wide
entries.description: Use a moderate 28mm full-frame-equivalent rectilinear lens to include useful environmental context and a sense of spatial depth. Keep nearby and distant elements proportionate, with straight lines remaining straight and no fisheye curvature, stretched corners or distorted lettering. The complete artwork must remain legible across the frame.

entries.label: Compressed view
entries.description: Photograph from farther away with a 70mm full-frame-equivalent rectilinear lens, gently compressing the apparent distance between architectural layers. Retain natural perspective and undistorted letter shapes while allowing the setting to form a clean backdrop. Frame the entire word clearly rather than cropping it through the narrower field of view.

entries.label: Centered
entries.description: Place the complete artwork prominently near the center of the frame, with deliberate breathing room around its edges and a balanced distribution of visual weight. Use surrounding architecture and small scale cues to establish size without competing with the painted word. Maintain a clear silhouette and keep every letter comfortably inside the image boundaries.

entries.label: Diagonal
entries.description: Arrange the viewpoint and architectural lines to create a purposeful diagonal movement through the composition, adding energy without making the artwork appear unstable. Let the diagonal support the viewer's eye through the complete word while preserving a clear reading order. Keep all essential letterforms inside the frame and visually dominant over the setting.

entries.label: Off-center
entries.description: Position the artwork deliberately away from the exact center and use the remaining frame for atmospheric architectural context and negative space. Balance that open area with credible forms, light and scale cues so the image feels composed rather than accidentally cropped. Keep ATLAS fully visible, prominent and easy to read.

entries.label: Brutalist
entries.description: Set the scene among monumental raw-concrete structures with board marks, exposed aggregate, deep recesses, massive stairs and heavy structural silhouettes. Use believable joints, cantilevers and durable urban infrastructure to convey scale and weight rather than fantasy geometry. Let the architecture frame the artwork and provide atmosphere without swallowing or forming its letters.

entries.label: Industrial
entries.description: Set the scene in a substantial working industrial site, with steel frames, service platforms, weathered cladding, pipes or loading structures arranged with credible construction logic. Show material differences such as oxidized metal, worn paint and concrete contact surfaces, plus realistic wear where equipment is exposed to weather. Preserve a clear view of the artwork and avoid turning infrastructure into typography.

entries.label: Urban plaza
entries.description: Set the scene in a spacious contemporary urban plaza with durable public architecture, paved ground and believable city context. Use restrained details such as seating, paving patterns, planters or distant facades to suggest a real civic place without cluttering the frame with readable signs or text. Keep the painted surface physically plausible and make the artwork the clear visual focus.

entries.label: Layered spray
entries.description: Render the artwork as several genuine aerosol passes, with fine overspray halos, visible pigment grain and selective controlled drips. Let color layers overlap naturally and follow the underlying surface texture, with believable coverage, edge softness and adhesion. Avoid the uniformly smooth finish of vector graphics or digitally pasted lettering.

entries.label: Brush and marker
entries.description: Show deliberate brush-painted fills with crisp marker outlines and subtle evidence of hand-applied strokes, bristle direction and changing pressure. Make the paint sit on the surface with realistic edges and slight texture, while the marker contour remains controlled rather than mechanically perfect. Keep the fills opaque enough for strong contrast and the outlines subordinate to readable letter shapes.

entries.label: Stencil layers
entries.description: Build the image from carefully aligned stencil-painted layers, with clean intentional boundaries and slight aerosol texture around selected edges. Suggest real masking and successive paint applications through small registration variations and believable coverage, not a perfectly digital overlay. Keep each color layer contained within the letter design and ensure the stencil treatment does not obscure the spelling.

entries.label: Rainbow
entries.description: Distribute a vivid but controlled full rainbow progression across the painted letters, with distinct red, orange, yellow, green, blue and violet passages that transition cleanly. Keep hue boundaries and highlights readable over the letter structure instead of dissolving into a random multicolor haze. Restrict the strongest saturation to the paint and keep surrounding materials visually cohesive and restrained.

entries.label: Red hues
entries.description: Use a coherent range of crimson, scarlet, vermilion and warm red highlights across the painted letters, with darker burgundy depth where shading is needed. Separate neighboring forms through value and surface detail rather than introducing unrelated dominant colors. Keep the surrounding scene comparatively neutral so the red paint reads clearly without clipping into featureless neon.

entries.label: Blue hues
entries.description: Use a coherent range of deep navy, cobalt, cyan and cool blue highlights across the painted letters, balancing dark saturated fills with lighter readable edges. Preserve enough contrast between adjacent shapes that their construction remains clear, and avoid turning the whole environment into a monochrome blue wash. Let concrete and metal retain believable neutral material colors.

entries.label: McDonald's red and yellow
entries.description: Use a bold, unmistakable combination of saturated red and bright golden yellow across the painted letters, with clear separation and balanced distribution of both colors. Add darker red shading and warm yellow highlights only where they help explain paint depth and shape; keep the palette vivid but controlled. This is a color treatment only: include no McDonald's logo, arches, lettering, packaging, brand mark or other branded object.

entries.label: Earth tones
entries.description: Use a cohesive palette of ochre, rust, warm ivory and deep brown across the painted letters, with subtle shifts between warm light and dark passages. Let pigment texture and tonal separation define the shapes rather than relying on intense saturation. Keep surrounding concrete, weathered metal and other materials naturally compatible with the muted earthy paint.

entries.label: Solarpunk
entries.description: Imagine a hopeful solarpunk future where neighborhood-scale solar arrays, wind towers, green roofs and carefully maintained water systems coexist with lush native planting and welcoming public architecture. Make the technology visible, useful and integrated rather than decorative: show repairable infrastructure, shared gardens and renewable power supporting everyday life. Use crafted natural materials and optimistic color palettes; let illumination and sky follow the supplied live conditions. Keep the ATLAS lettering physically painted into the scene and clearly readable.

entries.label: Steampunk
entries.description: Create a richly constructed steampunk setting in which Victorian-era engineering has advanced through mechanical ingenuity: riveted brass housings, pressure gauges, copper pipes, geared machinery and carefully maintained steam infrastructure. Every mechanism should have plausible supports, joins and purpose, with patinated metal, soot and visible wear conveying age and use. Keep ornament subordinate to the architecture, avoid arbitrary gadget clutter, and let all illumination follow the supplied live time-and-weather context while preserving a clear view of ATLAS.

entries.label: Cyberpunk
entries.description: Set the scene in a dense cyberpunk city shaped by advanced networks, surveillance hardware, modular display panels and unevenly distributed technology. Use layered cables, service access and credible high-rise construction to suggest a functioning, crowded metropolis rather than a fantasy collage. If emissive signage is visible, its brightness and any reflections must follow the supplied live time and weather; do not assume night, rain or wet pavement. Keep all signs abstract and unreadable so ATLAS remains the only legible word, with graffiti as a tangible human mark in the mediated environment.

entries.label: Post-apocalyptic salvage
entries.description: Depict a post-apocalyptic salvage settlement assembled from recovered industrial parts after infrastructure has failed. Show carefully repurposed steel, patched cladding, dismantled machinery, hand-built supports and visible repair decisions, with rust, dust and weather exposure explaining each material's condition. The setting should feel resourceful and inhabited rather than randomly ruined: salvage has practical function and stable construction. Keep the painted ATLAS lettering intact, prominent and unmistakably attached to a real surface.

entries.label: Post-war reconstruction
entries.description: Show a city undergoing deliberate post-war reconstruction, where damaged masonry and scarred concrete sit beside newly erected structural frames, repaired utilities and organized building materials. Communicate both loss and civic determination through safe work zones, temporary supports and evidence of careful rebuilding, without depicting active combat or sensational destruction. Let emerging infrastructure and human-scale signs of renewal define the atmosphere, and preserve a clear, physically plausible painted ATLAS artwork as part of the recovering place.

entries.label: Biopunk
entries.description: Envision a biopunk future where biotechnology, cultivated materials and engineered ecosystems shape the built environment. Suggest laboratories, translucent biofabricated panels, carefully controlled growing systems and organic forms supported by credible technical infrastructure, avoiding grotesque or uncontrolled mutation. Balance living textures with precise maintenance details so the world feels designed and inhabited. Keep the architecture photorealistic and make the painted ATLAS lettering a distinct, durable human intervention within this technologically transformed setting.

entries.label: Lunar technology outpost
entries.description: Place the architecture at a remote lunar technology outpost, with pressure-rated modules, dust-managed walkways, antennae, power storage and robotic service equipment arranged for practical operation. Show lunar terrain, fine regolith, a black sky and reflective thermal materials with technical accuracy. Any visible habitat light must follow supplied live time context rather than impose a separate lighting effect. Structures must appear sealed, anchored and connected rather than floating props. Integrate the ATLAS artwork on a sheltered panel, maintaining legibility and a convincing sense of scale.

entries.label: Climate adaptation
entries.description: Depict a technology-enabled climate adaptation district designed for severe heat, flooding and changing weather. Include raised pedestrian routes, floodable public space, shaded structures, water storage, resilient utilities and passive cooling measures whose construction is visible and credible. Let the environment communicate both climatic pressure and practical preparation without turning into disaster spectacle. Use material wear and water marks as evidence of lived experience, while keeping the painted ATLAS work prominent on a durable, believable surface.

entries.label: Interlocking bars
entries.description: Render the word exclusively as wildstyle graffiti, varying the formulation through tightly interlocked angular bars that weave across neighboring letterforms while preserving a distinct skeleton for each character. Use attached extensions, sharp cuts, layered depth and energetic hand-worked edges as parts of the same wildstyle treatment, not as a separate style. Keep the exact uppercase spelling ATLAS immediately legible to a normal reader; every flourish must remain subordinate to the letters, and no overlap may conceal or change their order.

entries.label: Explosive extensions
entries.description: Present ATLAS in unmistakable wildstyle graffiti, with a more explosive arrangement of pointed extensions, directional movement and overlapping angular structures radiating from the letter skeletons. This is a variation in wildstyle formulation only: retain interlocking construction, controlled highlights and a coherent five-letter word, without borrowing another graffiti style. Preserve clear ATLAS legibility at a glance, keep every extension attached to its letter, and ensure no flourish obscures, substitutes or adds a character.

entries.label: Layered wildstyle depth
entries.description: Describe a dense but controlled wildstyle graffiti treatment for ATLAS, emphasizing stacked angular bars, inset cuts, carefully layered paint depth and crisp highlights that reveal how the forms interlock. Keep the design recognizably wildstyle throughout rather than shifting into another graffiti style or generic lettering. Protect the silhouette and reading order of all five uppercase characters so ATLAS remains plainly legible; secondary bars and attached flourishes must clarify movement without hiding any essential stroke.

entries.label: Kinetic geometry
entries.description: Form ATLAS as energetic wildstyle graffiti whose interlocking angular letter skeletons create a strong sense of motion through slanted bars, attached hooks, sharp transitions and selective overlapping extensions. Vary the verbal treatment while keeping the same general wildstyle language, never introducing a different graffiti style. Make each of the five letters recognizable and the complete uppercase word ATLAS easy to read immediately, with controlled complexity, clear character order and no detached marks that could be mistaken for extra lettering.
